Landing from a jump has its own thump per surface, and the controller step rumble follows the surface.

entries.title: Real roads and sidewalks
items: Roads now have a smooth, steady grade along their whole length instead of following every bump of the hillside, and a flat road surface across (with a tiny crown) so they no longer tilt sideways on slopes.
Sidewalks sit at one even height next to the road with a taller kerb stone (a quarter block), and the verge beside the road blends into the hill as a clean slope instead of a wall or a ridge.
Main roads have a dashed centre line and white edge lines (none at junctions, bridges or tunnels). Bridges and tunnel mouths keep their old heights so decks still meet the road.
Cars no longer get stuck on steep roads and drive more smoothly. Add ?roads=0 to the address to see the old roads for comparison.

entries.title: NCC: Nisse Security Central has set up in Hamre
items: From 2 December the NCC, this world's Pentagon, stands on the lot on Hageteigen in Hamre where the black SUVs are parked: a five-sided concrete building round a courtyard, with a fence, a gate and guard hut with a barrier, a flagpole, a radar dish, a helipad and a lit sign. You can walk in: lobby with reception and visitor badges, an ops room with a huge valley map wall, a briefing room with evidence boards, a radio room, a break room with a cookie tin, and a corridor round the courtyard (with a hot-dog stand called Ground Zero).

Six NCC agents in black suits, sunglasses and earpieces (big yellow NCC on the back) work there and talk to you: press G. Each tells you more about what happened to the nisser, day by day, all of it spoken with subtitles. Their walkie-talkies crackle with overheard radio chatter when you stand near them.

Eight NCC field sites with yellow tape, cones, a black SUV and an agent appear around the valley one by one (the big nisse on the square, Camp Botnan, the penstock, the church, Orresteinen, the tent camp, Feda, Bowlinghallen). Six small NCC quests: a mitten, a lost cap, an evidence delivery, a photo, a thermos and an escort. Everything shows on the big map under the new NCC layer, and in Search.
Do not throw snowballs at federal agents. They carry a little silver pen called the Beamer. Three warnings, and then you will not remember where you were.

entries.title: One voice at a time
items: Only one person speaks at any moment: the witch, the Eye, the people who give you quests, Lykta, your own voice-over and the strangers on the trails now take turns through one speech director.

Nobody is cut off in the middle of a word. A new line waits for the one that is running, then a short natural pause (a bit longer when a different person answers). Only the witch jump scare may break in, and then the voice fades out quickly instead of cutting.
TV, radio and the carol singers dip softly while someone talks to you and come back smoothly afterwards; the game music dips and returns without pumping.
Subtitles share one lane: they no longer pile on top of each other (the TV subtitles only show when nobody else is speaking).
Old lines are dropped politely: a voice-over line about a place you have already left is not said late.

entries.title: Parachute
items: Falling from a mountain, a rocket or the jetpack? Press P (keyboard) or triangle (controller) while you fall and a red-and-white parachute opens, with a gold stripe at the front. Phone: tap the prompt.

You float down slowly, drift forward and steer with the movement keys or the stick. You land softly. Press P (triangle) again to fold it away, or just land. Without pressing anything, falling works exactly as before.
A fabric whump, wind that fades, a controller flutter when it opens and a soft hum while you float. The camera pulls back to show the chute.

entries.title: More treasure chests
items: 90 new treasure chests are hidden all over the valley: on summits (a little way from the green mailbox), on lake shores and small islands, behind waterfalls, under bridges, by cabins, barns and boathouses, along the penstock, at Camp Botnan, and on a few flat roofs in town.

Some chests hold fixed prizes (a long blue rocket, a golden rocket, 250 kr, a note with a hint). The others are regular chests with random loot: kr, snowball stacks, flares, thermoses, rockets, and now and then something silly like a single mitten. What is inside is rolled once for you, and it is different for each player.
Six secret chests are only shown on the big map once you have found the clue: sign certain summit books, or find certain things on the trails.
A small glint shows on a chest you have not opened when you are close. The map counts every chest, for example 3/102 opened. Open them with G, like the first ones.

entries.title: 27 more quests out in the wild
items: Farms, huts, summits, the fjord shore and the old road ends now have people with favours to ask, and eight new strangers walk the trails.
Some quests are chains across several places: a message passed from hut to hut, a lost dog, a tin of cookies that should not be opened, three lights on a ridge.
New kind of quest: sign the summit book at a varde for someone who cannot climb.
Every person with a favour shows on the big map under the QUESTS layer.

entries.title: Map layers
items: The big map has a LAYERS panel (the green button, or press L while the map is open). Switch things on and off: quests, treasure chests, shops, lantern doors, summit books, camps and landmarks, trail finds, friends online and pickups.
Treasure chests show on the map (closed ones as a chest, opened ones grey, with a count of how many you have opened). Trail finds only show the ones you have found. Your choices are remembered.
On the controller: L1 / R1 pick a layer, cross switches it on or off, triangle opens and closes the panel.

entries.title: A big map you can open
items: Click the little map in the top corner (or press N, or L1 + R1 on the controller) to open a big map. Drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom, C jumps back to you, 0 shows the whole valley, Esc or N closes it.
The map now shows who needs help: a yellow ! over every person with a quest for you, and a green ? where a reward is waiting. The quest you are tracking has an orange pulsing pin.
The game keeps running while the map is open, so take a quick look and close it again.

entries.title: The world feels alive: animals, strangers and things to find
items: Deer, reindeer, a moose now and then, foxes at dusk, hares, sheep on the farms and squirrels live around the trails. Each animal has its own sound, and they run if you come close and calm down when you stand still.
Flocks of small birds, ravens on the roofs, gulls at the water and an eagle circling high up. Fish jump in the lakes and the ice groans.

38 small things to find along the paths: cairns, abandoned cabins, benches with a logbook, hidden fires, notes in bottles, rune stones, lost mittens and more. Each gives a line of story and a tiny reward.

Eight strangers on the trails with something to say, spoken and subtitled: a hiker, an old fisherman, Agnes on her bench, sledding kids, a skier, a dog walker, a camper at Orresteinen and old Hans at the penstock.
Wind in the trees, owls and a far-off wolf at night, creaking snow. Everything vanishes and goes quiet in Threshold World.

entries.title: Small quests from the people you meet
items: People around the valley now have favours to ask: look for a yellow ! over their heads (a green ? means your reward is waiting) and press G to talk.

22 little quests: bring something, carry a parcel, find a lost thing, walk someone down a trail, answer a riddle, race the clock, or take a photo of a landmark (press H to hide the screen and frame it).
Rewards are kroner, rockets, flares, gløgg thermoses and hints. Every line is spoken and subtitled, and nobody talks over anybody else.
Press Q (or QUESTS in the top bar, or the pause menu) for the quest journal. Track one, and Lykta can show you the way.
Some of the strangers you meet on the trails have a favour to ask too.

entries.title: The opening flight shows the whole valley
items: Houses, shops, bridges and buildings are now there for the whole flight, from the fjord all the way to town, not only the trees.
A loading bar on the start screen builds the valley first, so the flight never shows empty ground.
Marius can fast-forward the intro with the right arrow (hold) and jump with a double tap on the arrows.

entries.title: Play together online (coming soon)
items: See Marius, Chris and Martin walking around town with a name above their heads.
Wave, laugh, dance and point with Z then 1 to 4, and chat with Enter.
Switched on once the little free server is set up. Until then nothing changes.

entries.title: New landmarks and nicer places around town
items: Orresteinen: the giant rock on Fedaheia, right on the cliff edge over Fedafjorden. Climb it, and find the photo spot.
Globen: the big rock with the pole and ball at the top of Hamre.
Camp Botnan: the tipi village, the gate with the eagle, the hut with a fire, swings and more.
Trail signs at path starts and forks all over the map, pointing to Varden, Globen, Botnan, Parkering and other places.
New paths: the top of Helleråsen and the top of Hamre are now joined up.
The Fedafjord bridge now looks like the real suspension bridge.
The little bridge at Krågehølen is now the old green steel bridge.
The pipe from the dam at Lona down to the old power station at Livrislien.
Martin's tennis court: concrete, white lines and a chain-link fence. Martin's house also has a driveway now.
The tall cabin at Hamre is bigger.
Spark race: SPACE gives a hard push, but go too fast and the sled gets wobbly and can throw you off.
The death screen now tells you what got you.

entries.title: Chris's top floor is finished
items: Go up the stairs in Chris's flat: the top floor has a hallway with a workout room, Martin's room, Chris's bedroom, a bathroom and a gaming room
The walls now go all the way up to the sloped ceiling, with white panels, wooden beams and Velux windows in the roof
The walls are solid and every room has a door that swings open when you walk up to it
Treadmill and weights, beds, desks and wardrobes, a hot tub at the end of Chris's bedroom, a shower and toilet, and a gaming room with a sofa, TV and a computer with RGB lights
Warm lamps in every room and a few Christmas things here and there
Downstairs you can walk into the kitchen again: the white bar across the floor is gone, and furniture no longer blocks the gaps between the counters

entries.title: Chris's flat, the noise challenge and the dungeon
items: Chris's flat furnished for real: kitchen, sofa with cushions, TV with fireplace channel, dining table, bathroom, a new bedroom, advent stars, candle arch, a decorated tree and stockings
NOISE CHALLENGE: G at the 'Chores for today' note on the fridge. Hold G at each chore (washing, vacuuming, dishes, music, frying an egg) without the noise meter reaching 100%. 3 minutes, +200 kr

The witch's DUNGEON: a spiral stair from her flat down to a corridor, cauldron chamber, jar room, crawl-space and bone room, 9–12 m underground. She appears behind you, drops from above and whispers in the dark
The dungeon is hidden until 8 December in the real game (open on Marius's Mac for building). No digging in her flat or under the house

entries.title: A lantern for the dungeon, and something waiting at the bottom
items: The dungeon is much darker now. Most of the torches have burnt out, and you can hardly see without a light
An old oil lantern hangs on a hook on the way down the spiral stairs. Press G to take it and carry it in your hand, with an oil gauge in the corner. G at the hook again fills it up
Keep an eye on the flame. Old lanterns sputter… and sometimes they go out
On 12 December something big happens down in the cauldron chamber. Bring the lantern

entries.title: Bowlinghallen comes alive
items: Staff: Stine (films), Geir (snack bar), Arild (shoe desk); 9 customers on the settees, at the arcade, the pool table and the film racks
Bowling: G on a lane (50 kr). Space locks aim, Space throws, hold A/D to curve. Real pins, 10-frame scoring, STRIKE/SPARE
Other people bowling on lanes 1, 4 and 5, with their own scores
Video racks: 178 films from the 80s to 2005 in 9 genres. Rent for 39 kr
Arcade: SNAKE, BREAKOUT and SAURON INVADERS (the Eye is the boss every 3rd wave). 5 kr a credit, top-5 high scores
Pool: 8-ball against Geir or trick-shot practice
Air hockey against the staff, first to 7

entries.title: Num num num
items: Near the witch's house you'll sometimes hear her eating: 'Num num num num num… Mmm, so crunchy.' (Nobody knows what yet.)

entries.title: Dev panel: walls & windows
items: New first tab WALLS & WINDOWS
Slim walls (12 cm) in 1, 2, 3 and 4 m, normal (2 m, fits one floor) or tall (3 m); any colour
Wall with window, double window, lit window, glass wall, half wall / bar, doorway, wide opening
Walls with a door (wood, white or glass) that swings open when you walk up
Windows to put into a block wall: square, double, tall, panorama, round, lit; doors and double glass doors (remove the blocks first, then place it in the hole)
Slim walls block you like real walls; doors and openings let you through

entries.title: High scores at Bowlinghallen
items: A big lit HIGH SCORES board on the back wall above the pins, with chasing bulbs and a pink neon glow. It shows the top 10: name, score and date
Finish a game good enough for the top 10 and you get a NEW HIGH SCORE! splash, a fanfare and a flashing board, then type your name (or tap CHRIS / MARTIN)
The game remembers the last name you typed
Marius gets a message on his phone about every finished bowling game, and the best scores are added to the board for everyone

entries.title: Two races
items: JETPACK RINGS: start by the river south of Stjerneporten (search T: 'Jetpack rings (start)'). 20 rings over the river, under the bridge and up to the cairn on Nonskarknuten. Each ring +2 s fuel. Win: medal, kroner, the Elytra and 64 rockets, then jump off and fly
SPARK RACE: top of Hamrevegen by the Hamre barns down to the roundabout, 1.7 km (search 'Spark race: Hamrevegen'). W kicks, A/D steer, S brakes, Shift/Space drift. Race Oddvar, Sigrid and Tor-Arne
The Eye can't hurt you during a race

entries.title: The Night Wing
items: A one-of-a-kind armoured flying car, parked on the square next to where you start
G to get in. On the ground it drives like a car
Space (or ↑) launches it on rockets: wings fold out and it flies
In the air: W/S throttle, A/D turn and bank, Space/↑ climb, C/↓ dive, Shift afterburner
Come in low and slow to land; the wings fold back in
G always gets you into a car you're standing next to

entries.title: The witch hates Christmas
items: 18 new lines: she hates Christmas, bans all Christmas lights and swears she'll tear them down
12 new threats: lawyers, the police, 'If this were America, I'd sue', 'You better watch out, young man'
8 new notes in Chris's mailbox and under the door
Test links (?at=) never drop you inside a building any more

entries.title: Wider, real Bowlinghallen
items: Bowlinghallen built from your own design: 5 lanes, VHS racks, arcade, pool table, WC, café
Glass double door that swings open on the side entrance, with the BOWLINGHALLEN sign above it
Second sign facing Åmotsvegen
90s music inside the hall

entries.title: Market vendors and spawn
items: A stall-keeper at each of the 4 market stalls on the square, with things to buy (G)
You now start and respawn on the square
Dev panel: SET SPAWN HERE button

entries.title: Dev panel: more tools
items: Eyedropper: I or middle-click copies whatever is under the cursor
20 new Christmas lights: strings, street garlands, icicles, roofline bulbs, curtains, arches, light trees, globes, reindeer
TV tower (60 m and 100 m)
Mailbox and the real mailbox stand at Krågehølen

entries.title: Chris's place
items: Chris's mailbox: look at it to see new letters, G to read notes from Downstairs
Wreaths removed from shop doors
Gutted the brick building at Hageteigen: one big open hall

entries.title: Sky and screen
items: Clouds you can fly through
On-screen clock
Clean film mode: H hides absolutely everything

entries.title: 17 town details
items: Parked cars in car parks (and no more buried cars)
Snow banks, road poles, bus stops and a bus, crossings and signs, bins, benches, bike racks
Candle arches and paper stars in house windows, julenek and nisse on the square
People with kick-sleds, prams and dogs, sledding kids, snowmen, chimney smoke
Church bells on the hour, playgrounds, icy river edges with reeds and boats
Sounds: snow crunch, passing cars, river, distant dogs, shop doorbells

entries.title: Fixes and new things
items: No more getting stuck on the ground or in midair
Extra: real entrance, floor and ceiling
Martin's tennis court in the right place
White, wider bridge (Stjerneporten) with green panels
Eye on/off button in Movie mode
Jetpack in your inventory (slot 5)
Dev panel for editing the world
